info.title: Flashduty Open API

post.description: Create an AI SRE automation rule with schedule and optional HTTP trigger settings.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **1,000 requests/minute**; **50 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | None — any valid `app_key` can call this operation |

## Usage

- Use `team_id=0` for a personal rule or a team ID for a team-owned rule.
- The request accepts a four-field cron expression; the response normalizes it to five fields with a leading zero minute.
- If `http_post_trigger_enabled` is true, the response includes a one-time `http_post_token`. Save it immediately; later reads do not return it.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log. Do not place secrets in request fields.

post.description: Stream a session's full event transcript as newline-delimited JSON.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **1,000 requests/minute**; **50 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | None — any valid `app_key` can call this operation |

## Usage

- The response is `application/x-ndjson` — parse line-by-line and write to a file; do not buffer the whole body in memory.
- The first line is always a `session_meta` envelope; `include_subagents=true` inlines each child session's stream after its dispatch line.

200.description: Streaming NDJSON (application/x-ndjson). One JSON object per line, terminated by a newline. The first line is always a `session_meta` envelope; subsequent lines are session events.

schema.description: Newline-delimited JSON stream. Parse line-by-line; do not buffer the whole body.

x-mint.content:
## Restrictions

| Aspect | Value |
| ------ | ----- |
| Rate limits | **30 requests/minute**; **3 requests/second** per account |
| Permissions | **Skill Manage** (`ai-sre`) |

## Usage

- Send as `multipart/form-data` with a `file` part. Max archive size is 100MB.
- Set `replace=true` to overwrite an existing same-name skill.
- Every call is recorded in the account audit log.

AppKeyAuth.description: App key issued from the Flashduty console. Required on every public API call. Keep it secret — it grants the same access as the owning account.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request — usually a missing or malformed parameter.

error.message: The specified parameter skill_id is not valid.

Forbidden.description: The app_key is valid but lacks permission for this operation.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit hit. Either the global API limit or a per-account limit.

ServerError.description: Unexpected server-side error. Include the request_id when reporting.

error.message: We encountered an internal error, and it has been reported. Please try again later.

ErrorCode.description: Flashduty error code enum. Every failed API response sets `error.code` to one of these values. The value is a stable wire string — not a localized message and not a numeric status. HTTP status is informational.

DutyError.description: Error payload inside the response envelope. Present only on non-2xx responses.

message.description: Human-readable error message, localized by the caller's Accept-Language. May contain field names, IDs, or other context from the failing request.

ResponseEnvelope.description: Standard response envelope used by every Flashduty public API. On success `data` contains the endpoint-specific payload and `error` is absent. On failure `error` is present and `data` is absent. `request_id` is always present and is also mirrored in the `Flashcat-Request-Id` response header.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this request. Mirrored in the Flashcat-Request-Id header. Include it when reporting issues.

data.description: Endpoint-specific payload. See each operation's 200 response schema.

ErrorResponse.description: Response envelope for errors. `error` is required; `data` is absent.

SessionGetRequest.description: Fetch one session plus a backward-paged window of its most recent events.

SessionExportRequest.description: Export the full event transcript of one session as a streaming NDJSON body.

is_mine.description: True when the caller created this session.

can_manage.description: True when the caller may rename/archive/delete the session.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the session was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last session update.

template_staging_round_id.description: Current save→validate round id (template-assistant only); empty otherwise.

state.description: Raw session-state bag (session-scoped keys). Omitted when empty.

current_context_tokens.description: Size in tokens of the LLM context window as of the most recent turn. 0 means no turn has completed.

context_window.description: The bound model's max context size in tokens. 0 means unknown.

archived_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when archived; 0 means not archived.

pinned_at.description: Caller's per-user pin timestamp in milliseconds; 0 means not pinned.

last_event_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the most recent assistant-side event.

is_running.description: True when an agent turn is currently in flight for this session.

has_unread.description: True when there is assistant output the caller has not yet viewed.

SessionGetResponse.description: A session plus a backward-paged window of its events.

has_more_older.description: True when older events remain beyond this page.

search_after_ctx.description: Opaque keyset cursor; pass back as search_after_ctx to fetch the next older page. Omitted when has_more_older is false.

total.description: Total number of sessions matching the filter (ignoring pagination).

EventItem.description: One persisted session event. content/actions/usage_metadata carry the raw ADK envelope; treat them as opaque structured payloads.

invocation_id.description: ADK invocation id grouping a turn.

author.description: Event author (e.g. user, the agent name).

branch.description: ADK branch path for nested agents.

actions.description: ADK actions envelope (state deltas, transfers, escalation).

partial.description: True for a streaming partial chunk.

turn_complete.description: True on the terminal event of a turn.

error_code.description: Error code when the event represents a failure.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the event was written.

SessionTokenUsage.description: Cumulative session-level token rollup across all turns. The account-billing source of truth.

input_tokens.description: Total prompt (input) tokens, including the cached portion.

cached_tokens.description: Portion of input_tokens served from the prompt cache.

EnvironmentBinding.description: The runner or cloud sandbox the session is bound to. Null until the first message.

ContextResolvedItem.description: Snapshot of the three-tier knowledge-pack resolution for this session.

incident_id.description: Bound incident id, when war-room originated.

resolved_at_ms.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the packs were resolved.

AutomationRuleCreateRequest.description: Configuration for a new AI SRE automation rule.

team_id.description: Scope owner. Use `0` for a personal rule or a team ID for a team rule.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is enabled immediately after creation.

cron_expr.description: Four-field cron expression in API format: hour, day-of-month, month, day-of-week.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Override the schedule trigger state. Omit to keep the default enabled state.

prompt.description: Task prompt executed on every automation run.

environment_kind.description: Preferred execution environment. Omit to let the backend auto-pick.

environment_id.description: Concrete BYOC runner ID when `environment_kind` is `byoc`.

http_post_trigger_enabled.description: Whether to provision the HTTP POST trigger alongside the schedule trigger.

AutomationRuleUpdateRequest.description: Partial update of an AI SRE automation rule. Omit fields you do not want to change.

team_id.description: Move the rule to another scope. `0` = personal rule.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Enable or disable the schedule trigger.

environment_kind.description: Preferred execution environment. Set to `null` or omit to leave unchanged.

environment_id.description: Replacement BYOC runner ID. Use an empty string to clear the binding when switching away from BYOC.

http_post_trigger_enabled.description: Enable or disable the HTTP POST trigger.

rotate_http_post_trigger_token.description: Rotate the HTTP trigger token. The previous token becomes invalid.

AutomationRuleIDRequest.description: Select one automation rule by ID.

AutomationRuleListRequest.description: Pagination and visibility filters for listing automation rules.

team_ids.description: Optional team filter applied after scope resolution.

include_person.description: Legacy scope switch. When `scope` is omitted and this is `false`, only team rules are returned.

keyword.description: Substring match against the rule name.

AutomationRuleListResponse.description: Page of automation rules visible to the caller.

AutomationTemplateListRequest.description: Locale override for loading automation templates.

AutomationTemplateListResponse.description: Preset templates that prefill new automation rules.

AutomationRunListRequest.description: Filters for the run history of one automation rule.

rule_id.description: Automation rule ID whose run history to query.

started_after_ms.description: Only include runs whose start time is on or after this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

started_before_ms.description: Only include runs whose start time is on or before this Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

AutomationRunListResponse.description: Page of automation execution history rows.

AutomationRuleItem.description: Public view of one AI SRE automation rule.

team_id.description: Rule scope. `0` = personal rule; `>0` = team rule.

enabled.description: Whether the rule itself is enabled.

run_scope.description: Derived scope used at execution time.

cron_expr.description: Stored cron expression. The backend normalizes four-field API input to a five-field form with a leading minute `0`.

prompt.description: Task prompt executed on every run.

environment_kind.description: Preferred execution environment. Empty string means auto-select.

environment_id.description: Selected BYOC runner ID, or an empty string when the backend auto-picks.

schedule_trigger_id.description: Schedule trigger ID when the rule has a cron trigger.

schedule_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the schedule trigger is enabled.

http_post_trigger_id.description: HTTP POST trigger ID when the rule exposes an API trigger.

http_post_trigger_url.description: Relative trigger URL. Send a `POST` with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

http_post_trigger_enabled.description: Whether the HTTP POST trigger is enabled.

http_post_token.description: One-time plaintext HTTP trigger token. Only returned immediately after create or token rotation.

can_edit.description: Whether the caller may edit this rule.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the rule was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the rule was last updated.

AutomationTemplateItem.description: Preset automation-rule template returned by the backend.

description.description: Short description of what the template does.

enabled.description: Whether the template is currently offered to end users.

AutomationRunItem.description: One execution row in an automation rule history table.

occurrence_key.description: Idempotency key for the trigger occurrence.

attempts.description: How many attempts have been made for this run.

started_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the run started.

completed_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the run completed. `0` means it is still running.

duration_ms.description: Run duration in milliseconds. `0` while a run is still in flight.

stats_json.description: Arbitrary JSON metrics captured for the run.

result_json.description: Arbitrary JSON result payload captured for the run.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the run row was created.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the run row was last updated.
